result.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
result.comment: Technical Report; 28 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables; Project page at https://enderfga.cn/SolarRenderer Code at https://github.com/Enderfga/SolarRenderer
result.summary: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.

AI.brief_summary: SolarRenderer 是一个结构条件视频渲染器：以冻结的 MiniMax-H3 骨干加两个轻量 LoRA，把布局/运动/相机的结构视频作为参考输入，并用四步分布匹配蒸馏实现快速渲染。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作目标是按粗结构补全外观的高效视频渲染与蒸馏加速，材料未涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据筛选、答案使用或停止决策等主线问题，缺乏可用于 LVR 的具体借鉴线索。
